recipes_empty: No recipes yet. Add your first one.
error_source_url_invalid: Enter a valid http:// or https:// address.
import_hint: Fills empty fields from the page's recipe data.
import_error_page_unreachable: Couldn't load that page. Check the address and try again.
import_error_page_blocked: Systems aren't allowed to read this site.
import_error_page_too_large: That page is too large to import.
import_error_no_recipe_found: No recipe found on that page. Please fill in the details manually.
import_error_description_not_parsed: The video description has no clear ingredients or steps headings. Please fill in the details manually.
steps_hint: Use **bold**, *italic*, [red]colour[/red] or [link text](https://example.com). Start a line with > to add a note to the step above it.
error_image_invalid: Please upload a PNG or JPEG image.
error_image_too_large: That image is too large (5 MB limit).
error_no_text_found: No ingredient text found in that image.
error_ocr_failed: Couldn't read the screenshot. Try again.
ingredients_conflict: This recipe already has ingredients. Add the new lines to them, or replace the list?
error_clipboard_unavailable: This browser can't read the clipboard. Use the file button instead.
error_clipboard_denied: Allow clipboard access for this site to paste the image, or use the file button.
error_no_image_on_clipboard: There's no image on the clipboard. Take a screenshot first, or copy one.
image_empty: No image yet. Choose a file or paste a screenshot.
ingredients_hint: One ingredient per line. To group ingredients under a section name, start that line with # and the name, such as # Filling. The lines below it belong to that section. Start a line with > to add a note to the line above it.
error_save_failed: Couldn't save the recipe. Check that the app's server is running, then try again.
error_load_failed: Couldn't load your recipes. Check that the app's server is running.
delete_confirm: Delete {n} recipe(s) permanently? This cannot be undone.
archive_note: Archived recipes are hidden from the list. Delete them here to remove them for good.
tags_hint: Tap to choose. Dashed tags are suggested from the recipe's words.
tags_limit: A recipe can have up to {n} tags.
recipe_start_hint: For a video: where the recipe begins, such as 4:30.
tags_none: No recipes have all these tags.
translation_reset_confirm: Discard your edits to this translation and translate it again automatically?
translation_stale: The original text has changed since this translation was saved. Check it.
signin_error_wrong: That email or password isn't right.
signin_error_other: Couldn't sign in. Try again in a moment.
signin_error_expired: That took too long. Sign in again.
signin_new_password_hint: The owner gave you a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.
signin_new_password_weak: Use at least 8 characters, with upper and lower case letters, a number and a symbol.
install_intro: Add Recipes to your home screen. It opens full-screen, like an app.
install_address: Open this address on your phone:
install_ios_steps: Open the address in Safari. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
install_android_steps: Open the address in Chrome. Open the menu, then Install app.
install_qr_caption: Scan with your phone camera to open the app.
line_delete_confirm: Delete this line in every language? Its notes go too.
translation_misaligned: This edited translation no longer matches the recipe's lines, so it is not shown. Use machine translation to start again.
original_edit_note: Original text: edits here change the recipe in every language
note_empty: A note can't be empty. Write something in it, or leave it as it was.
photo_no_new_lines: Every line in this photo is already in the recipe.
share_translate_failed: The translation is not ready, so the original text will be sent.
share_no_photos: This phone cannot attach photos, so only the text was sent.
share_failed: Sharing did not work. Try Copy text.
shopping_not_translated: Not translated, so these lines may not join other recipes:
select_hint: Press and hold a recipe to select several.
glossary_hint: Each fix replaces a word before a recipe is translated, so it applies to every recipe in that language.
glossary_empty: No translation fixes yet. Fix a word in a translated ingredient and the app will offer to remember it.
